title: A+ Core 1 & 2
overview: Start your tech career with CompTIA A+, the industry standard certification for entry-level roles. Trusted by employers worldwide, A+ builds foundational skills in hardware, software, networking, troubleshooting, and security. The latest version, V15, is updated for today’s technology and prepares you for roles like IT support specialist and help desk technician through two exams—Core 1 and Core 2. Install, configure, and maintain hardware components and devices effectively.
skills_measured: Review the official CompTIA exam blueprint for a detailed breakdown of skills measured.
prerequisites: Recommended experience: 12 months of hands-on experience in an IT support specialist job role
